_about: A small Old West cast to try Library > Import cast with. Some entries give every detail, some only a few (the rest is rolled from the Old West tables), and one is a free description that drives the art on its own. Columns NPC Forge does not know (id, shift, quest) are kept untouched in npc.custom, which is how game data such as schedules or stats can travel with a character.
